title: HelperSSHHomeResult
description: What the home probe answered: the far account's home directory, or the empty string when the host could not say. It is a VALUE and not an exec result, unlike its four siblings, because this probe is two commands and a rule — ask $HOME, then fall back to the tilde for a shell that answers nothing — and the rule belongs to the probe's definition (internal/remoteprobe), not to each caller. A raw stream would put that rule one process out and let two copies of it disagree.

home.description: The home directory as the far side reported it, trimmed. Empty is a state the caller reports rather than guesses around.
